Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium landscape editorial project cover for the Sandbox home carousel, not a product screenshot.
Primary request: an exceptional cinematic visual evoking Song Maker, a local music workshop that generates songs, separates recordings into tracks, edits and mixes them.
Scene: a sophisticated midnight recording studio imagined as a tactile architectural still life. At the center-upper area, elegant translucent cyan and warm amber sound ribbons travel in parallel layers, crossing above a compact black music production mixing console and a small section of piano keys. Carefully crafted rotary knobs, brass details and dark brushed aluminium. The sound ribbons suggest separate musical stems joining one beautiful composition. A discreet physically grounded black computing unit in the background suggests local processing.
Style: extraordinary photorealistic 3D art direction, crafted design magazine cover, macro material detail, cinematic depth, controlled highlights, poetic and beautiful, not a generic technology icon.
Palette: deep near-black and graphite, striking luminous cyan, restrained warm amber accents. Dramatic soft volumetric studio light.
Composition: landscape 16:10, central memorable subject occupies middle and upper two thirds, generous safe cropping to landscape and square. Lower 28 percent is dark uncluttered negative space for the website caption, with no important objects there. Subject and light shapes immediately readable at thumbnail size.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no fake software interface, no people, no humanoid robots, no product name. Do not depict an authentic screenshot or imply hardware sold with the application.

Primary request: an exceptional cinematic visual evoking Sillage, an independently hosted workspace that coordinates coding agents, project tasks, shared instructions and Git work.
Scene: an elegant three-dimensional architectural desk sculpture in a midnight studio. Three independent dark glass computing cores, each subtly different in proportion, are arranged around a central translucent workbench. Luminous cyan and fine amber trails connect the three cores, weaving into a perfectly ordered lattice of floating blank translucent task tiles and branching paths. The paths suggest shared context and collaborative coding work, with depth and refined spatial organisation. Keep the number of objects restrained: an iconic memorable central sculpture, not visual clutter.
Style: extraordinary photorealistic 3D editorial artwork, collectible design-object photography, graphite metal, optical glass, precise fine copper details, cinematic depth of field and tactile realism. Beautiful coherent sculptural composition rather than a flat diagram.
Palette: deep near-black and graphite, luminous cyan dominant, restrained warm amber highlights. Dramatic soft volumetric studio light.
Composition: landscape 16:10, central subject occupies middle and upper two thirds, safe crop to square. Lower 28 percent is dark uncluttered negative space for the website caption, no important objects there. Strong clear silhouette readable at thumbnail size.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no code characters, no logos, no watermark, no fake screenshot, no real product UI, no people, no humanoid robots, no invented brand. These are metaphorical computing objects and blank tiles, not features beyond task organisation, agents, shared context and branches.
